title: melocactus pedernalensis subsp. caloxanthus
intro: Melocactus pedernalensis subsp. caloxanthus, commonly known as the Golden Pitaya, is a species of cactus in the genus Melocactus. This plant is valued for its edible fruits and is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Melocactus pedernalensis subsp. caloxanthus include its potential to soothe digestive issues and provide relief from pain, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
